description: load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a leak scenario at pipe '785' and '786' with a leak area of 0.05 m² and 0.02 m² occurring from 18000 to 36000 seconds,, run the hydraulic simulation, and then plot the time series of flow rate through pipe '785' and '786'.

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a chemical booster scenario at node '1' using the SETPOINT method with a strength of 1000 and an activation pattern from 2h to 15h, run the water quality simulation and plot the time series of quality through node '9'.

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a chemical booster scenario at node '1' using the CONCEN method with a strength of 1000 and an activation pattern from 2h to 15h, run the water quality simulation and plot the time series of quality through node '9'.

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a chemical booster scenario at node '1' using the MASS method with a strength of 1000 and an activation pattern from 2h to 15h, run the water quality simulation and plot the time series of quality through node '9'.

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a chemical booster scenario at node '1' using the FLOWPACED method with a strength of 1000 and an activation pattern from 2h to 15h, run the water quality simulation and plot the time series of quality through node '9'.
load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a contamination event at node 'O', run a water quality tracer simulation, and plot a time series plot of tracer percent for node 'A'
load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a power outage for pump '1Ag1' from 3600 to 7200 seconds, run the hydraulic simulation, and plot the time series of the this pump's status

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate a fire event at junction '1' with a demand of 0.2 LPS from 3600 to 7200 seconds, run the hydraulic simulation and plot the time series of flow rate through link '1849'.

load 'data/richmond.inp', simulate an earthquake with an epicenter at (14000, 6000), magnitude 6.5, and depth 10000 m, and visualize the PGA distribution associated with each link across the network as a topology map.
